title: Re-point platform-core.seed-mode-matrix: the seed default mode is ignore since #30152, the item still pins upsert
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · platform-core.seed-mode-matrix · acceptance[5]

A stale-spec FAIL in the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`), rule R-1 there. Both sides behave as their own declarations say; the checklist item pins the shape that PR #30152 changed.

## What changed

PR #30152 ("a seed is create-only by default — an omitted `mode` is `ignore`", merged 2026-11-04): `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` line 207, `mode: SeedMode.default('ignore')`, and `seed-loader.zod.ts` line 253, `defaultMode: SeedSchema.shape.mode`. The resolution seam `dataset.mode || config.defaultMode` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` line 1303) is unchanged.

## The re-point

In `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`:

- steps[0]: "`defaultMode` to 'upsert'" → 'ignore';
- acceptance[0]: "upsert (the default)" → upsert, with ignore named as the default;
- acceptance[5]: "('upsert')" → ('ignore').

Bump the revision and add a history entry citing #30152. The runner also noted, for steps[0]: an unprefixed draft object makes the whole publish-drafts answer `publishedCount 0`, and a plain `DELETE /meta/object/NAME?package=` cannot remove a draft-only item (`POST /packages/ID/discard-drafts` does).
